articles.summary: RICHMOND, Va. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--May 26, 2026-- Tredegar Corporation (NYSE:TG) today announced that Dr. Susan Sweeney will join the company as Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), effective June 1, 2026. Dr. Sweeney will report directly to the CEO.
